text: Program Introduction While the business world is becoming increasingly borderless, those who will eventually stand out are expected to contribute to a sustainable business growth on an international scale. For example, these people should have a thorough understanding of business and should be confident in collaborating with people from different cultural backgrounds. Participating in this unique program allows you to learn first -hand about how to understand cultural concepts and develop a sustainable competitive advantage in an increasingly challenging and volatile business environment. Furthermore, you can develop a mindset to take initiatives in leading strategic changes with global implications. Curriculum It consists of four units of study (32 credit points), comprising: 9 core courses; 2 elective courses; 2 project courses (click the picture to enlarge) Study Duration 2 years
